text:
maria chen: incident-bot fired a paging alert for streaming: p99 decode latency spike >10s on prod-streaming, routing to eng-oncall + eng-runtime.
incident-bot: [ALERT] 2026-03-15T12:04:36Z - paging-tail spike - p99 12.3s - channels: eng-oncall, eng-runtime, eng-sre
ashwin patel: i'm oncall, grabbing traces now. can someone confirm recent infra changes in the last 6h? @olivia any deploys?
olivia: pushed TRT8 + FlashAttention variant (v1.2.0) and a kernel compilepatch with new flags ~2.5h ago (deploy at ~09:30 UTC). linking the deploy IDs.
ryan: customer impact: a subset of dedicated customers (acme-corp + some beta orgs) saw streaming stalls and occasional 502s. filing PG ticket #12345, updating status page.
maria chen: logs show repeated compilepath retries and pagefault churn during decode tail. looks like kernel/compilepath interaction with new flashattn kernels.
nashwin patel: commands i'm running:
```
kubectl logs -l app=runtime -n prod --since=3h | grep -E "pagefault|KV::evict|decode stall"
```
nashwin patel: traces show compilepath lock contention + increased pagewalks after compiler flag `-fno-earlyalloc` introduced in the build.
ops-sre: starting targeted rollback on one node group to validate. executing runbook: `runbook rollback compilepath-flag-v2` on canary pool.
olivia: repro locally with seq_len=2048 + TRT8+FlashAttn: p99 jumps to ~11s, KVCache eviction rate spikes. memory layout differs after kernel tweak.
maria chen: proposed mitigation: revert the compiler flag on canary + pin TRT8 variant back to v1.1.8 for a subset of pools. recommend canary -> 10% -> 30% -> 100% rollout.
nashwin patel: initiating canary rollback on us-west-2-gpupool-3 now. will monitor p95/p99 and pagefault metrics.
incident-bot: update: rollback initiated by ashwin patel at 12:25 UTC
ryan: customers notified via support; Acme informed separately. ETA for mitigation 30-45m.
olivia: additionally seeing `KVCache::evict` spikes correlated with pagefault counts — likely memory mapping differences triggered by the new kernel build.
maria chen: temporary config mitigation: enable prefix-KV caching for streaming routes to reduce pagewalk pressure. command to apply: 
```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/v1/routes/patch \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -d '{"route":"streaming","kv_cache":true,"cache_ttl":300}'
```
nashwin patel: canary results: p99 dropped from 12.3s -> 0.9s after removing the flag and pinning TRT to v1.1.8. rolling to 30% now.
ops-sre: caution — watch capacity and OOMs when swapping kernels at scale. rolling too fast could cause scheduling pressure.
ryan: support note: sending targeted status update to affected customers and support owners. updating PG #12345 with latest metrics and ETA.
maria chen: list of artifacts to capture for postmortem: kernel build id, compiler flags diff, TRT8 build hash, exact deploy window, affected pool list, customer impact window, streaming request traces.
olivia: followups assigned: olivia -> deep triage of TRT8 variant + flashattn interplay; ashwin -> automation for safe rollback/hotpatch; ryan -> customer comms and SLA assessment; ops-sre -> capacity plan for rollback rollforward scenarios.
maria chen: handing off to overnight oncall @dave. please keep this thread updated and attach logs to the postmortem doc. @incident-bot escalate to paging-escalation if p99 > 5s persists.
incident-bot: Escalation rule triggered: paging-escalation channel notified.
dave: ack taking over. will validate rollback completion and watch for regressions during night. handoff notes saved to runbook.
nashwin patel: rollback rollout: 10% -> 30% -> 100% completed by 13:02 UTC. p99 stabilized around 0.8s, retries reduced.
ryan: status page updated: "Mitigation in progress — rolling rollback of recent kernel/compile flags. Target resolution ETA 30m"
maria chen: final action items: schedule RCA meeting, reproduce in staging with identical kernel + TRT build, add regression test to canary pipelines, and add a guard against this compiler flag without KV memory-safety vetting. postmortem template: https://redwood.infra/postmortems/2026-03-15-compilepath-paging (please tag eng-runtime + eng-sre).
incident-bot: Incident closed automatically after 2h of stable metrics.
maria chen: thanks all — good mitigation. we'll reconvene tomorrow for the deep dive. :thumbsup:
